Maritime Managed Services Definition of Managed Service Provider: ​ Manages and assumes responsibility for providing a defined set of services to its clients either proactively or when determined that services are needed. We are a Veteran owned and operated Managed Service Provider. ​ We specialize in creating custom managed services designed specifically for Super-Yacht Clients ​ We understand that no two Vessels are the same and pride ourselves in our ability to create our client's customized plans and pricing with their individual needs in mind. ​ We will create a service and support plan that caters specifically to your Owner, Guest, Captain, and Crew's needs . ​ When planning your charter, you don't have time to worry about the AV and Internet. ​ You need AV and IT systems that are installed and maintained with your needs specifically in mind. ​ We do it right the first time. ​ We can also provide crew augmentation and offer ETO service for individual charters. Meet Our Team! bottom of page
